name: Rock snail
summary: Ốc đá is on the Bản Đôn list. The 16 May 2022 market article also says ốc suối and, in the goods list, ốc núi. Vietnam Airlines says it is a rainy-season snail. VnExpress heads the same snail ốc núi and captions a photograph ốc đá. The price is Check on arrival.
origin: The Thanh Hoa Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism at Bản Đôn and at Phố Đoàn, Vietnam Airlines, and VnExpress, 3 Jul 2023.
texture: Vietnam Airlines says the snail is small, chewy, fragrant, and very sweet.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: steamed with lemongrass, or fried with lime leaf, and only in the rainy season. The Bản Đôn list does not print a season. Both stand.
VnExpress: boiled, steamed with ginger, a salad, or stir-fried, dipped in chẩm chéo rather than sweet-sour fish sauce.
The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Bản Đôn and Phố Đoàn. VnExpress says the snail lives in rock crevices and forest caves.
seoTitle: Rock snail in Pu Luong — oc da, oc suoi, oc nui
seoDescription: Ốc đá, also called ốc suối and ốc núi, is the valley snail. Rainy-season on Vietnam Airlines. Boiled, steamed, or stir-fried on VnExpress. The price is Check on arrival.
